title: EvoRisk: Autonomously Discovered Regime-Adaptive Resilience-Aware Financial Metric

mechanism.domainTask: Autonomous discovery of a volatility-, tail-, and drawdown-aware financial performance metric for asset selection and portfolio allocation
mechanism.populationDetail: The described AlphaSharpe loop retains a top-performing cohort to seed the next generation, implying multiple candidates; no explicit population data structure or size is given.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate elite archive is described; a top-performing cohort seeds the next generation within the described loop.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The cohort and pruning description is high-level AlphaSharpe lineage context, not a specified EvoRisk population implementation.
mechanism.generationDetail: The AlphaSharpe discovery loop combines LLM generation of metric formulations with mutation/perturbation and crossover/recombination; the paper does not specify edit scope or recombination arity.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Statistical fitness rankings and previous success/failure hypotheses guide evolution, but the exact feedback passed to the LLM is not described; no auxiliary evaluator metadata is specified.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Crossover and mutation are mentioned, but parent sampling, scope, and arity are not stated.
